full_judgment:
Badrul Haider Chowdhury, J:—This appeal by special leave is directed against the judgment and decree passed by the High Court Division in Appeal from Original Decree No. 7 of 1973. 

 3. The trial court decreed the suit and on appeal it was affirmed by the High Court Division. The contract and the payment of consideration were not denied by the defendant but he canvassed that the suit ought not to have been decreed inasmuch as another essential terms of the contract was yet to be performed by the plaintiff. It is contended the plaintiffs were to pay to the defendant six annas share of the profits from the business accrued till December, 1961 and according to his calculation his share of the profits come up to Tk. 50,000/- out of which he received only Tk. 5,000/-. Since the plaintiffs failed to perform this part of the contract the suit should not be decreed. Reliance was placed on section 24 of the Specific Relief Act. The High Court Division considered that the term was not essential of the contract therefore affirmed the decree that was passed by the trial court.
